title: LeHami: Symplectic Latent Dynamics for World Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.15267v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn world models directly in latent space, but unconstrained autoregressive predictors may contract the latent distribution over long rollouts. We introduce Symplectic Hamiltonian JEPA (LeHami), which replaces the standard predictor with an action-conditioned Hamiltonian flow over a structured latent state (q, p) integrated using an exactly symplectic leapfrog step. This construction preserves phase-space volume at every rollout step and rules out uniform contraction, asymptotically stable fixed points, and merging of distinct latent states, independently of the learned parameters or action sequence. We obtain the momentum-like component from temporal derivatives of the learned position-like representation, providing an explicit second-order state for prediction and control. On conservative and actuated visual pendulum environments, LeHami substantially improves long-horizon velocity p

translated_title: LeHami：面向世界模型的辛潜变量动力学
translated_abstract: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）直接在潜空间中学习世界模型，但无约束的自回归预测器可能在长时程推演中使潜分布发生收缩。我们提出了辛哈密顿JEPA（LeHami），它用一个动作条件下的哈密顿流替代标准预测器，该哈密顿流作用于结构化潜状态并使用精确的辛蛙跳格式进行积分。这一构造在每一步推演中都保持相空间体积不变，从而排除了均匀收缩、渐近稳定的不动点以及不同潜状态的合并，且与所学参数或动作序列无关。我们从所学位置类表示的时间导数中获得动量类分量，为预测与控制提供了一个显式的二阶状态。在保守型和驱动型视觉摆环境中，LeHami显著提升了长时程速度预测性能。
tldr: LeHami用精确保持相空间体积的辛哈密顿流替代标准预测器，解决了JEPA世界模型在长时程推演中潜分布收缩的问题，并为预测与控制提供显式二阶状态，在视觉摆环境中显著提升长时程速度预测性能。
en_tdlr: LeHami replaces the standard JEPA predictor with a symplectic Hamiltonian flow that exactly preserves phase-space volume, preventing latent distribution contraction over long rollouts and providing an explicit second-order state that substantially improves long-horizon velocity prediction.
